name: @litsen/lfwin-payment-mcp
description: LFWin payment MCP server for AI agents. Creates cashier payment orders, returns QR-code display fields, queries by platform order_no/orderid, creates refund requests, and queries actual refund status.

tools.name: create_payment_order
tools.description: Create a cashier payment order. The input merchant_order_no is the merchant mch_orderid for business correlation only. On success, save the returned order_no, which is the platform orderid for later query/refund calls. Display payment using pay_qrcode_markdown when Markdown is supported, the image content block when supported, pay_qrcode_image as an img src/data URL, pay_qrcode_base64 with pay_qrcode_mime_type for raw-base64 image rendering, or pay_url/qrcode as fallback. See payment_display_examples in the result for concrete display snippets.

tools.name: query_payment_order
tools.description: Query payment order status by platform order_no/orderid returned by create_payment_order. Do not pass merchant_order_no here; the underlying merchant-order query requires order_time and is not this tool's parameter contract.

tools.name: refund_payment_order
tools.description: Create a refund request by platform order_no/orderid returned by create_payment_order. Do not pass merchant_order_no. Use a unique mch_refund_no for each refund attempt, especially for multiple partial refunds. A response status of 4001 or 10000 means the refund request was accepted or is processing, not that the refund succeeded; call query_refund_status next.

tools.name: query_refund_status
tools.description: Query actual refund status by platform order_no/orderid. If mch_refund_no was used when creating the refund, pass the same value to locate the refund. status=4001 means processing; status=10000 with refund_status=1 means success; status=10000 with refund_status=2 means failed.
